name: ResNet18
description: A lightweight and reliable classification model that offers a good balance between accuracy and computational cost. A strong general-purpose choice for most datasets.

name: ResNet50
description: A deeper and more powerful version of ResNet that can achieve higher accuracy than ResNet18. Best suited for larger datasets and when accuracy is more important than inference speed.

name: ConvNeXt
description: A modern convolutional network designed to achieve strong classification performance while maintaining the efficiency of CNNs. A good choice when higher accuracy is preferred over lightweight inference.

name: EfficientNetB0
description: A highly efficient model that provides a strong balance between accuracy and computational cost. A good choice when both performance and efficiency are important.

name: MobileNetV2
description: A lightweight model optimized for mobile and edge devices. Recommended for fast inference and applications with limited computational resources.

name: ShuffleNetV2
description: An extremely lightweight model designed for fast inference on resource-constrained devices. A good choice when low latency and minimal computational cost are the main priorities.
